extDescription.message: Turns the whole page you are viewing, including the part you scroll to, into one image.

offscreenJustification.message: Combines the captured page into one image and copies it to the clipboard.

errResize.message: The window was resized during capture, so it stopped. Please try again.

errRestricted.message: The browser does not allow capturing this page.

errGeneric.message: Could not capture the page. Reload it and try again.

errStalled.message: The capture stopped partway. Please try again.

warnTruncatedY.message: The page is very long, so the bottom is cut off.

warnTruncatedX.message: Content that overflows sideways is not included.

warnBlocked.message: The page stopped scrolling partway, so the image ends there.

warnElement.message: The scrolling area inside the page was unrolled, rather than the whole window.

progStartDetail.message: Leave the page as it is.

progCopyDetail.message: Combining the screenshots into one image.

progMultiDetail.message: The page was split into $1 images. Copy the rest with the buttons.

progManualDetail.message: The image could not be copied automatically.

progCopyRetry.message: Could not copy. Press the button again.

progNoSession.message: Try again from the toolbar button.

copiedPaste.message: Copied. Paste it into your chat.

copiedNthPaste.message: Copied image $1. Paste it into your chat.

copiedImagePaste.message: Copied the image. Paste it into your chat.

previewCapturingStatus.message: Scrolling and capturing the page. Keep that tab in front until it finishes.

previewCapturingStatusAt.message: Scrolling and capturing the page ($1). Keep that tab in front until it finishes.

noteSplit.message: The page is long, so it was split into several images. Paste them from the top down.

noteSharp.message: Exported at high resolution, so the image is large.

noteShrunk.message: The width was reduced so the image is easy to paste into chat.

statusCopyMany.message: Copy the images you need and paste them into your chat.

statusCopyOne.message: Copy the image and paste it into your chat.

copyFailedManual.message: Could not copy. Right-click the image to copy it, or download it.

assembleFailed.message: Could not assemble the image. Please capture again.

previewIdle.message: Use the toolbar button to capture the page you are viewing.

sessionMissing.message: The capture data was not found. Please capture again.

resStandardHint.message: Up to 1280px wide. A good size for pasting into chat.

resScreenHint.message: Keeps the width you see now.

resSharpHint.message: Keeps the display's pixels. About twice the size on Retina screens.

savedOk.message: Saved. It applies from the next capture.

saveFailed.message: Could not save. Please choose again.
